## Service approach
HydroSeal evaluates surface material, existing sealer or coating, joint condition, moisture, staining, drainage, and surrounding property before selecting cleaning or sealing methods. Paver work may include cleaning, targeted stain treatment, re-sanding, small repairs or releveling, and compatible breathable sealer. Travertine is treated as natural stone and uses stone-safe cleaning and breathable protection. House and roof cleaning use lower-pressure soft-wash methods where appropriate.
